reviews.x: Disclaimer: I'm the spouse of the man using this product. I was excited to buy this for him since I adore the smell of tobacco leaf. If you're not experienced with what that smell is, don't think "cigarettes" or smoke when you see this term used; Tobacco is a subtly sweet and warm, earthy scent. It's a nice beard oil -- absorbs quickly and leaves his beard far more supple than if he forgot to apply any oil. (Which he does often enough that I need to remind him. *cough*) I'm a big fan of most sce

Scent reminds me of a well used humidor. With a nice vanilla scent. Beard and face are softer, and the liquid is not thick but thinner so is easy to rub in. Problem is thedroppwr will drip out product so keep your hand under it when you pull it the bottle.

It's not the best. The scent is ok. My beard and face seem ok with it though. It gets it's job done in a completely functional way without being as fancy as the other guys and I appreciate that. For the price, this is a great product.
My son loved this. The smell wasn't real strong which was great. It's a nice and mellow scent. Was a good gift.
Smells so good and my facial hair isn't itchy anymore. Amazing.

Very surprised at the high quality fot such a low price. Soaks into beard nicely, not overly oily and provides all day softness and scent. The scent is a great manly scent, a bit old timey cologney, like what i imagine someone with a study that has a fireplace and a high wingback chair wears in their beard. They have many leather bound books lining the wallz and a globe that opens into a whiskey and scotch decanter. Highly recommend if this is what you aspire to, it would be a big first step int

Well, what else would you want to know outside of a girl enjoying the scent of vanilla and tobacco, a manly scent with vanilla...great for a gift, for the guy that has everything...(except proper facial care for that manly beard.  The line also carries complementary facial wash for the beard.  So far, I’ve been told it is working well.  Haven’t seen any increased growth as of yet, but I wouldn’t have been able to review it fir a awhile if I was waiting on a beard to fill in!

reviews.t: Great smelling and works very well
reviews.x: I  am new to the bearded world and needed something that would keep my beard soft.  I figured I would give this a try because I had never tried a product that smelled like tobacco and vanilla.  Well to my surprise it smelled very good(the wife loves it) and it not only keeps my beard soft with daily use, it also has helped moisturize my skin so I no longer get that mid day itch from it being dry.  I would recommend this product.

I bought this for my husband. His beard is thick and usually requires quite a bit of moisture. This oil works really well for him. With just one application, my husband's beard remains soft and shiny the entire day. It smells so good!
Great product at a great price. Comes nicely packaged. Scent is pleasant but I smell more vanilla than tobacco. Still, the scent lasts nearly all day in my epic Viking beard.
Allows grooming without greasy feeling.  Love the tobacco/vanilla smell, understated instead of overwhelming.  Very pleased.
Nice, light scent.  Leaves my beard very soft and easy to brush.  I use it after every shower.

reviews.t: Smells great! NOT over powering tobacco scent.
reviews.x: I was hesitant as a non-smoker to try this, but it's the small is great! And will buy again!
I gave this product to my son-in-law as a gift

This is the nicest smelling beard oil I've used. I had it for a couple of days before heading off for a weekend trip and I would use multiple applications throughout the few days I had it just because it smelled so damn good.  The one sketchy thing I notice right away was how the seal (the thin plastic below the twist-top) seemed to janky. I honestly couldn't tell if it was supposed to stay on or snap off because it didn't come off easily like it noormally would on a similar bottle of liquid. Su

reviews.t: Great subtle smell, keeps hair in place
reviews.x: My Husband has a beard but works in a professional setting and needs to keep it well groomed.  He says it's moisturizing but not too oily feeling. He's been using it a couple weeks now without any breakouts or bad reaction. It does a nice job keeping his beard smooth and put together. I love the scent, it's slightly sweet but subtle. The price point is a plus. He had been using Jack Black products which are nice but a little more pricey. It was nice too find an  alternative with quality ingredie

reviews.t: Husband loves it and so do I
reviews.x: I got the Vanilla and Tobacco scent for my husband for christmas. He has a goatee and feels embarassed buying himself beard oil since he doesn't really have a beard. He loves it and he loves the scent. Only problem is he doesn't want to use it except for special occasions because he likes it so much he wants it to last forever!  So it has only helped a little to make it more soft because he doesn't use it regularly. That is not the oil's fault though.

Gave to my son for his birthday. He loves the smell and quality of this beard oil. I will buy more for him! The scent is strong at first but then in about 5 minutes it mellows out to a wood based tobacco,( like a good cigar) with subtle notes of vanilla. It also made his beard softer and manageable. It works so good! We are pleased and recommend this beard oil.

reviews.t: Favorite scent of all so far...
reviews.x: I got this for my bf. He doesn't like beard balms, he prefers oils. He has tried a few different brands, and this is one of his favorite so far. The scent is really nice, and lasts pretty much all day. Although the scent lasts all day, it's not super strong, you can smell it when you get really close... So if you wear cologne, it won't get in the way.

For the price you can't beat this beard oil. I really like the vanilla and tobacco scent. For me it is very subtle, but enjoyable. It lasts about half the day and the oil itself absorbs nicely. My wife is very scent sensitive and has not complained at all when I wear this, even just out of the bottle. Good job Shash!

Removed the fall beard itch and added smooth oils to my dry beard! Couldn’t as fir a better smell my wife and the ladies at work noticed the fragrance with smiles. Great scent and lasted a long time fir a small bottle. Would buy again!!

Been using this for about a week now.  It works just as well or even better than most of the big name brands on the market. Feel in beard is spectacular and the scent is pretty nice as well. This is a gem of a beard oil.

I love this stuff-I believe it has a few uses. The one that I use it for is as a pre shave before applying shaving cream. I think or like to believe that it helps with a closer less cut shave-def endorse this product.

I thought I'd give this a try because it was a good value with decent ratings.  But you get what you pay for...it dried my face out pretty bad. I tried it a couple times and then tossed it. I wouldn't buy it again
Guys. Don’t buy non scented beard oil. Its nasty. This oil is subtle but oh so nice. It’s the best I’ve used so far.  My wife likes it and I enjoy the subtle scent through out the day.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scent, describing it as a pleasant vanilla and tobacco aroma that is mellow and not overpowering.
Many customers report that the oil softens their beard and leaves it feeling soft and easy to manage.
Several reviewers consider the product a good value for the price.
Some reviewers note the scent leans more toward vanilla than tobacco.
A few reviewers mention issues with the bottle or packaging, such as the dropper dripping or a questionable seal.
